CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFUPDATE

CFUPDATE is the companion of CFINSERT. The form must contain a field named after the table's primary key; that field picks the row, and the other fields whose names match columns supply the new values.

Category

Database manipulation

Syntax

<CFUPDATE DATASOURCE="ds_name"
    TABLENAME="table_name"
    TABLEOWNER="owner"
    TABLEQUALIFIER="qualifier"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    FORMFIELDS="field_names">

Attributes

DATASOURCE
Required. Data source that holds the table.
TABLENAME
Required. Table to update.
FORMFIELDS
Optional, default all fields. Comma-separated list of form fields to use. Include the primary key field. Without it, every name in Form.FieldNames that matches a column is used.
TABLEOWNER
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
TABLEQUALIFIER
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
USERNAME
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
PASSWORD
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

The KoldFusion flat-file driver keeps no catalog of keys, so the first column of the table is taken to be the primary key (CommentID for Comments, Emp_ID for Employees). If the form has no field with that name, a Database exception is thrown. Columns that are not in the form keep their old values; if no other field matches a column, nothing happens at all.

A common pattern is an edit form that carries the key in a hidden field: <INPUT TYPE="Hidden" NAME="Emp_ID" VALUE="#Emp_ID#">.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Edits comment 3, then puts it back the way it was --->
<CFQUERY NAME="Original" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT CommentID, Subject FROM Comments WHERE CommentID = 3
</CFQUERY>
<CFIF IsDefined("Form.CommentID")>
  <CFUPDATE DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" TABLENAME="Comments" FORMFIELDS="CommentID,Subject">
  <CFQUERY NAME="Changed" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  SELECT Subject FROM Comments WHERE CommentID = 3
  </CFQUERY>
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
  <TR><TD>Subject before</TD><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(Original.Subject)#</TD></TR>
  <TR><TD>Subject after CFUPDATE</TD><TD>#HTMLEditFormat(Changed.Subject)#</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
  </CFOUTPUT>
  <!--- Restore the original subject for the next visitor --->
  <CFQUERY DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  UPDATE Comments
  SET Subject = <CFQUERYPARAM VALUE="#Original.Subject#" CFSQLTYPE="CF_SQL_VARCHAR">
  WHERE CommentID = 3
  </CFQUERY>
  <P>(The original subject has been restored.) <A HREF="cfupdate.cfm">Try again</A></P>
<CFELSE>
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <FORM ACTION="cfupdate.cfm" METHOD="POST">
  <INPUT TYPE="Hidden" NAME="CommentID" VALUE="#Original.CommentID#">
  Subject of comment #Original.CommentID#:
  <INPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Subject" SIZE=30 VALUE="#HTMLEditFormat(Original.Subject)# - is my PC Y2K OK?">
  <INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Update">
  </FORM>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>
